_notes.title: The page's name, shown in the corner and the browser tab.
_notes.tracks: Your songs, in play order: [{"file": "music/song.mp3", "title": "Song name", "artist": "Artist"}]. Each file path is relative to this inputs file; MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, and FLAC all play in Chrome. Leave the list empty to get a 24-second demo track.
_notes.scene: The scene the page opens on: terrain, orb, tunnel, or rings.
_notes.theme: The colors: neon, ember, or mono. Each has a light and a dark look that follows the device.
_notes.sensitivity: How hard the scenes react, from 0.5 (calm) to 2 (wild). 1 suits most music.
